source.title: Tracking data and scripts of analysis to investigate griffon vulture avoidance in Grands Causses, France
source.author: Yohan Sassi
source.source_tracking_movebank_name: Eurasian griffon vulture in France ID_PROG 961
source.native_study_id: UNCONFIRMED (name only); not known to equal previously opened Scacco study IDs
source.original_paper: Empirical and simulation data reveal a lack of avoidance of wind turbines by Gyps fulvus (Griffon Vulture)
source.data_overlap_warning: Don't count as a new independent study until source parent, tag-ID and deployment source are cross-checked with Scacco 2026 original Gyps panels 122120597 and 44080734.

stages: Verify Dataverse exact version, published bytes and MD5 via official REST metadata
Retrieve original published public 1.09GB ZIP once (or first use range ZIP directory if byte-range support allows), SHA/bytes verify
List ZIP member paths/sizes and inspect CSV column names only; NEVER parse altitude values or missingness in this gate
Identify bird ID, tag ID, UTC timestamp, longitude/latitude, original movement state/source GPS velocity and target source years.
Only if raw source is truly per-event GPS, inspect ID/time/XY and date support at 5km, preserve all 2019–2021 source years before opening heights.
source_preoutcome_screen.source_event_filter: Use archived GPS speed if present 5–55m/s; if absent inspect native schema and do not infer flight behavior from weather or heights. No invented flight proxy.
source_preoutcome_screen.time_thinning: First valid native timestamp+coordinate event per bird UTC day×5-minute bin BEFORE opening numeric GPS altitude.
source_preoutcome_screen.tags: Map individual ID to tag/deployment IDs and source study years; flag aliases/confounded stable sensor identity.

prospective_biology_only_if_source_passe.question: Does within-bird, within-fine-horizontal-site vertical profile response transfer better across days under similar independently reconstructed thermal/wind and verified behavior states than by a shared-species weather reaction alone?
prospective_biology_only_if_source_passe.shared_model: species-wide same-site, same-month meteorological response, trained leaving out focal bird and target day; compare to bird-specific response on matched target GPS points
prospective_biology_only_if_source_passe.vertical_variable: Source native GPS height above ellipsoid/MSL or barometric pressure; must confirm source meaning and device precision before selection, use DEM where possible; if absent source is structurally unavailable.
prospective_biology_only_if_source_passe.null: 999 matched whole-bird-day Wstar label randomizations within source month/environment blocking, 950 valid minimum, no split of same day's fix across train/test
prospective_biology_only_if_source_passe.source_independence: Require distinct animal tracking parent from Scacco *Gyps fulvus* 2016–2024 and from other published Sassi reexports; if overlap, mark as source-dependent and do not count as independent support.

boundary: This branch is source structural feasibility only; positive/negative height individuality outcome unknown and not tested. CC-BY public source does not guarantee same GPS height or mode fields.
